sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
questions.target: Sine, cosine, and tangent ratios
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 3$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 3) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 3$.
questions.explanation: Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 3) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 3$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for sine, cosine, and tangent ratios consists of the four values $\{18, 22, 26, 32\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Sine, cosine, and tangent ratios
questions.answer: Final Answer: $24.5$. The sum is $18 + 22 + 26 + 32 = 98$, and dividing by $4$ gives $24.5$.
questions.explanation: The sum is $18 + 22 + 26 + 32 = 98$, and dividing by $4$ gives $24.5$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 6x + 5$ in sine, cosine, and tangent ratios, evaluate $f(3)$.
questions.target: Sine, cosine, and tangent ratios
questions.answer: Final Answer: $23$. Substitute $x = 3$: $f(3) = 6(3) + 5 = 23$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying solving for sides in right triangles, $m\angle A = 50^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Solving for sides in right triangles
questions.answer: Final Answer: $85^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (50^\circ + 45^\circ) = 85^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (50^\circ + 45^\circ) = 85^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $4\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.target: Solving for sides in right triangles
questions.answer: Final Answer: $8\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $4 \times 2 = 8\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $4 \times 2 = 8\mathrm{\ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 3$ passes through $(0, 6)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$? Show your complete algebraic work.
